title: Console: a page's lookup targets are asked one name at a time, and a target the host does not register answers 404
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYK6SZCmyzbGnrvmkk

Filing gate: ① found while measuring objectstack-ai/cloud#4300 (hosted console calls to routes the host does not serve). Dedupe: `meta/object 404 lookup target`, `sys_business_unit 404 control plane`, `readPageObjectScope names-only`. Related, closed: #33343 item 2 (PR #33499 made `lookupTargetNames` skip `hidden: true` fields for a member's record page). This card is the other half: a visible lookup whose target the host does not register at all, for every caller, admin included.
Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#4300 (Blocked-by this card; closes on a pin bump and a re-measure).

## 维护者速读

- 要做的：页面的查找字段目标对象，宿主没注册的就不要逐个按名字去请求（用批量读取，或者按已经拿到的对象列表过滤）。
- 为什么：控制平面「成员」页因为 `sys_invitation.business_unit_id` 去请求 `sys_business_unit` 的定义，控制平面没有业务单元，得到 404；无包的应用走逐个请求，有包的应用走批量读取（#29444）就没这问题。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What happens

The control plane's Members page (`page/team`, which binds `sys_member` and `sys_invitation`) asks `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_business_unit` and is answered 404; the control plane registers no business units. Measured as platform admin on cloud main 7317e42 with the framework at b914e7247f (18.5.0).

- Target source: `sys_invitation.business_unit_id` (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-invitation.object.ts:434`), a visible lookup.
- Caller: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts:292` (`readPageObjectScope` adds each bound object's lookup targets). In an app with no `_packageId` the names-only scope asks each name with its own request; the package arm uses the batch `GET /meta/object?names=` that leaves an absent name out (#29444). The console has already read `GET /api/v1/meta/object` in the same load.
- Same class, to cover in the same change: the staging note on objectstack-ai/cloud#4300, `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_approval_request` 404 on a Free environment opening HotCRM pages (not re-measured).

## Change

1. A lookup target the host does not serve is not asked by name: the names-only scope uses the batch read, or filters targets by the served object list.
2. Done when a test pins that a page bound to an object with a lookup to an unregistered object makes no per-name definition request for it, and a registered target still resolves.

Seam: `spec:sys_invitation.business_unit_id` → `renderer:appObjectScope readPageObjectScope`.
